Loren Schoenberg has distinguished himself in the jazz world as a tenor saxophonist, band leader, jazz educator, and Director of the Jazz Museum of Harlem.
He was interviewed in New York City on January 14, 2019 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
